test_case.test_name: Front USB3 slot1 40C/-5% rails 12-hour margin stress
test_case.purpose: Verify the identified front USB3 slot1 sustains a full 12-hour SST workload at measured 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails without link fallback, data, reconnect, kernel or BMC errors.
required_package: Calibrated chamber/rail source and approved load test points
test_case.test_command: Operator maps slot/tool, preserves baseline, calibrates and ramps rails downward at the approved rate to measured -5% while holding 40C, verifies USB3 topology/speed, runs pinned SST for 12 hours with synchronized rail/temperature, link, integrity and error evidence, then ramps rails/ambient to nominal and verifies port/system health.
test_case.expected_result: The tool remains on the required USB3 path/mode for the complete in-tolerance interval, SST/data integrity pass, no disallowed retry/reconnect/kernel/SEL event occurs, and nominal restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires load-point -5% proof, correct USB3 identity/speed, full 12 hours, integrity/log evidence and restoration. +5% or nominal results, fallback speed, shortened stress or cleared SEL cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified operator and approved low-rail limits/ramp
Independent source/load voltage and temperature measurement
Abort on undershoot, controller/link/data or system instability
Preserve evidence, controlled nominal ramp, no auto-retry
expected_evidence: USB3 speed/link and full SST/integrity output
test_case.recovery: On rail, USB or workload fault, stop stress, preserve evidence, return rails and ambient to nominal through the approved controlled ramp, verify port/system health and do not automatically repeat.
